semantics: These are reading leads (candidate C references), not claims or established RSM Certificates. A later investigated finding can cite specific passages and contain a Certificate.
limits: OSTEP's book starts OS execution at the process abstraction; its chapters 4/6 do not constitute a full firmware/bootloader how-to.
Older OSTEP text is a conceptual source, not implementation documentation for a current kernel.
Questions may map to overlapping routes. Chapters are stored once and referenced by their numbers.
